popup.title: The Shattered Realm
popup.body: The old kingdom is split between you and three warlords, each richer than you. Let them bleed each other in the middle — expand where they are weakest and unify the realm.

popup.title: The warlords mobilize
popup.body: All three warlords are raising fresh warbands.

popup.title: The people rally
popup.body: Your just rule draws volunteers from across the realm.
